svg.title: Core pipeline: load, compute and store
svg.text: Core pipeline: load, compute and store
(a) Processes, channels and events of one core (src/model.cpp)
acquire slot; per panel b: wait for
tile's INT8 outputs; free the slot
panel_consumed event: a non-final panel finished, its buffer is free
Memory port: serial DMA, or AXI read and write channels (src/memory.cpp)
transport(MemRequest) blocks the issuing process until the request's done event
(b) Stage timelines from npu-sim --trace: M 24, N 8, K 96, tiles 8 x 8 x 32, 16 MAC/cycle, axi memory, S = 2
label t.p: tile t, reduction panel p. Dashed arrow: the load that waits for a panel buffer.
